nodes.title: Frontend Architecture
nodes.content:
# React Frontend System

**Project Location:** `Front-End/client/`

**Technology Stack:**
- React 18+
- React Router v6
- Axios for HTTP
- Modern CSS/Styling
- Node.js environment

**Build System:**
- package.json: `Front-End/client/package.json`
- Public assets: `public/`
- Build output: `build/`

nodes.title: Entry Point
nodes.content:
## `public/index.html`

**Location:** `Front-End/client/public/`

**Purpose:**
- HTML shell for React app
- Contains `<div id="root">` mount point
- Links to CSS/fonts
- Meta tags

**Served by:**
- React dev server (dev)
- Django static files (prod)

nodes.title: Source Code
nodes.content:
## `src/` Directory

**Main Files:**
- `index.js` - App initialization
- `App.js` - Root component
- `App.css` - Global styles

**Organization:**
- Components
- Pages/Views
- Services (API calls)
- Utils/Helpers
- Hooks (custom)
- Context (state mgmt)

nodes.title: Pages/Views
nodes.content:
## Main Pages

**Typical Pages:**
- Dashboard - User overview
- Lessons - List all lessons
- Lesson Detail - View single lesson
- Quiz - Answer tasks
- Profile - User settings
- Login/Register - Auth screens
- Progress - Track learning

**Navigation:**
- React Router (v6)
- BrowserRouter for SPA

nodes.title: React Components
nodes.content:
## Component Structure

**Types:**
- **Page Components** - Full screens
- **Container Components** - Logic & state
- **Presentational Components** - UI only
- **Hooks** - Reusable logic

**Common Patterns:**
- Props for data flow
- State management (useState)
- Effects (useEffect)
- Custom hooks
- Context API

nodes.title: API Service
nodes.content:
## API Communication

**Tool:** Axios

**Base URL:**
- Dev: `http://localhost:8000/api/`
- Prod: Backend domain

**Features:**
- Automatic cookie handling
- Error interceptors
- Request/response logging

**Main Endpoints Called:**
- GET `/api/lessons/` - Fetch lessons
- POST `/api/token/` - Login
- POST `/api/register/` - Signup
- GET `/api/progress/` - User progress
- POST `/api/tasks/<id>/submit/` - Submit answer

nodes.title: State Management
nodes.content:
## State & Context

**Options:**
- useState - Local component state
- Context API - Global state
- useReducer - Complex state
- Custom hooks - Logic reuse

**Common State:**
- User info (logged in?)
- Current lesson
- Answers submitted
- UI state (loading, errors)
- User preferences

nodes.title: Styling
nodes.content:
## CSS & Styling

**File:** `App.css` + component CSS

**Approaches:**
- CSS files (component.css)
- Inline styles (style prop)
- CSS modules
- CSS-in-JS (optional)

**Responsive:**
- Mobile-first design
- Media queries
- Flexbox/Grid layouts

nodes.title: Build & Deploy
nodes.content:
## Build Process

**Tools:**
- npm scripts (package.json)
- Create React App (if used)
- Build output: `build/`

**Scripts:**
- `npm start` - Dev server
- `npm build` - Production build
- `npm test` - Run tests

**Deployment:**
- Static files → Django `/static/`
- Or separate frontend server
